current.text: He is expected to come off the bench as a scorer, likely as the seventh man. One earlier note also named him an outside option for the open fifth starting spot.
Four Minnesota starters are set: Ball, Edwards, McDaniels and Gobert. The fifth spot is open, and Kuminga and Josh Green are both named for it.
Minnesota's bench is thin, with little scoring punch, which leaves room for a bench scorer.
Experts call him often overhyped: a low-usage scorer who adds little else.
With the season ending March 28, Minnesota's playoff schedule goes 4, 2, 4 games, so the semifinal week (starting March 15) has only two games.
Minnesota has 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum.
Minnesota is expected to compete (one expert predicts 53 wins), so it should not rest players to tank.
